g.title: BEGIN
g.text: Verify admitted head and quartet digests
Read board and exact task registry
Order Pending requests by durable queue ordinal

g.title: VISIT
g.text: Parse canonical request and verify grant,
revision, task, scope, reservations and causality

g.title: SELECT
g.text: validate report, or build annotation preview
Add request to selected group and byte total

g.title: RESULT
g.text: Progress = selected or rejected count is positive

g.title: RENDER
g.text: One renderer call for the changed batch

g.title: COMPLETE
g.text: Publish and verify quartet images as needed
Persist coherent commit receipt and next head
